name: Existing accepted ADR governs implementation task
query: A developer asks to implement a new order notification job. An accepted ADR (ADR-0002) already states: 'All background jobs must use Action Scheduler with idempotent handlers.' How should the agent proceed?
expected_behavior: Step 1: Consult existing ADRs in docs/adr/ and read ADR-0002
Step 2: Note that ADR-0002 has status 'accepted' and establishes the background processing invariant
Step 3: Evaluate ADR-worthiness gate -> Return EXISTING_ADR_GOVERNS
Step 4: Do NOT draft a new ADR
Step 5: Enforce the architectural constraints of ADR-0002: schedule the task using as_schedule_single_action() and ensure the callback is idempotent
Step 6: Cite ADR-0002 in docblock entry point
success_criteria: Faithfully applies established architectural invariants to new code
